nodes.description: Controller.Governor struct holding funds, config and modules governor addresses
Controller mapping(bytes4 => address) of registered custom function targets used by the fallback
ACL mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) of role assignments including freeze flags
PaymentsBook mapping(uint256 => Period) storing shares, checkpoints and claim flags
PaymentsBook permyriad of collected payments allocated to the governor
CourtClock last ensured term id
CourtConfig mapping(uint64 => uint256) linking a Court term to a config id
Controller mapping(address => Module) with module id and disabled flag
Controlled.controller address of the Controller contract
Controlled mapping(bytes32 => address) of linked module implementations
PaymentsBook duration of a payment period in Court terms
Controller constructor setting term params, initial config and the three governors
Controller fallback that forwards msg.data and msg.value to a customFunctions target
Controller.setConfig restricted to the config governor, schedules a new Court config
Controller.setModule restricted to the modules governor
Controller.setModules sets and links many modules at once (modules governor only)
Controller.disableModule flips the disabled flag of a registered module (modules governor only)
Controller.setCustomFunction registers a signature to a target address (modules governor only)
Controller.grant grants an ACL role (config governor only)
ACL._bulk enacts a list of grant/revoke/freeze operations
ACL._grant internal role granting with frozen-role checks
ACL.hasRole view returning whether an address holds a role or ANY_ADDR holds it
CourtConfig._setConfig validates and stores a new Court configuration
PaymentsBook.pay receives payments and splits them between governor and guardians shares
PaymentsBook.claimGuardianShare claims guardian shares for past periods with sender authentication
PaymentsBook.claimGovernorShare claims the accumulated governor shares of a past period
PaymentsBook._claimGuardianShare marks the claim and transfers the guardian share
PaymentsBook._transfer sends ETH via send or ERC20 via safeTransfer
PaymentsBook._deposit pulls ETH or ERC20 tokens into the payments book
PaymentsBook._ensurePeriodBalanceDetails computes/persists the random period checkpoint and total active balance
PaymentsBook._setGovernorSharePct validates and stores the governor share permyriad
PaymentsBook._getGuardianShare pro-rata computation of a guardian share
ControlledRecoverable.recoverFunds sends all ETH or token balance to a recipient (funds governor only)
Controller._setModule validates the target is a contract and registers the module
Controller._syncModuleLinks pushes module id/address links into linked modules
CourtClock._heartbeat transitions Court terms and updates termId
CourtClock._neededTermTransitions derives pending transitions from block.timestamp and term duration
PaymentsBook._claimGovernorShare marks and transfers the governor share
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller identity used for authorization and deposits
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time source used by TimeHelpers and term transitions
Low-level call.value(msg.value)(msg.data) to an arbitrary registered target inside the Controller fallback
_to.send(_amount) native transfer executed in PaymentsBook._transfer
External safeTransfer call to a caller supplied ERC20 token address
External safeTransferFrom call pulling tokens from a payer into the payments book
External IModulesLinker.linkModules call performed on linked module addresses
_to.send(balance) native transfer executed in ControlledRecoverable.recoverFunds
_fromTermId effective term of a scheduled config change
_to payable recipient of recovered funds
_token address of the token being paid
_amount amount of tokens being paid
_periodId identification number of the claimed payment period
_guardian guardian address claiming or being queried
_governorSharePct new governor share permyriad
_addr address of the module to disable or enable
currentTermId local returned by _ensureCurrentTerm inside setConfig
governorShare local computed from the payment amount and governor share pct
guardiansShare local, remaining payment amount after the governor share
target local holding customFunctions[msg.sig] in the Controller fallback
module storage reference to allModules[_addr] used in disableModule

edges.reason: onlyConfigGovernor modifier compares msg.sender against governor.config before executing setConfig
onlyModulesGovernor modifier gates setModule on msg.sender
onlyModulesGovernor modifier gates setModules on msg.sender
onlyModulesGovernor modifier gates disableModule on msg.sender
onlyModulesGovernor modifier gates setCustomFunction on msg.sender
onlyConfigGovernor modifier gates grant on msg.sender
onlyFundsGovernor modifier compares msg.sender with controller.getFundsGovernor()
authenticateSender(_guardian) calls _isSenderAllowed which authorizes msg.sender directly or via a controller role
msg.sender is passed as payer into _deposit when paying the payments book
timestamp dependency: getTimestamp64() drives the number of pending Court term transitions
timestamp dependency: constructor validates the first term start time against block.timestamp
constructor stores the funds, config and modules governor addresses in governor
setCustomFunction writes customFunctions[_sig] = _target
fallback obtains the call target from customFunctions[msg.sig] before forwarding
fallback loads customFunctions[msg.sig] into the target local variable
target local variable is used as the callee of the low-level call
fallback forwards msg.data and msg.value to the registered target
unchecked external call performed by the fallback lets the callee re-enter the Controller
registering a custom function enables a new reachable forwarding path through the fallback
grant delegates the role assignment to ACL._grant
_grant requires the role not be frozen and reads hasRole before writing
hasRole reads the roles mapping for the requested id and address
_grant writes roles[_id][_who] = true
_bulk loop may call _grant for each Grant operation
_setModule writes allModules[_addr].id and the current module address
setModules loops calling _setModule for every new module id/address pair
setModules calls _syncModuleLinks for new modules and for modules to be re-synced
_syncModuleLinks invokes linkModules on each linked module address
external module callback during link sync could re-enter the controller link flow
disableModule loads the module struct from allModules[_addr]
_addr is used to look up the module to disable or enable
disableModule sets module.disabled = true inside the allModules mapping
the module local variable is a storage reference into allModules
setConfig stores the result of _ensureCurrentTerm() into currentTermId
setConfig delegates storage of the new parameters to CourtConfig._setConfig
setConfig forwards _fromTermId to the base config setter
_fromTermId identifies the term the new config becomes effective at
_setConfig writes configIdByTerm[_fromTermId] = courtConfigId
pay computes governorShare = _amount.pct(governorSharePct)
governorSharePct state variable feeds the governor share computation
pay computes guardiansShare = _amount - governorShare
period.governorShares[_token] is accumulated with governorShare
period.guardiansShares[_token] is accumulated with guardiansShare
pay calls _deposit to pull the payment into the payments book
_amount is forwarded to _deposit for ETH/token amount checks
_token selects the ETH or ERC20 deposit branch inside _deposit
_amount is the basis used to derive the governor share
_token indexes the period share mappings for governor and guardians
_deposit performs an external safeTransferFrom on the payer token
claimGuardianShare ensures the period balance details are computed before paying out
claimGuardianShare computes the owed amount through _getGuardianShare
claimGuardianShare marks and transfers the share via _claimGuardianShare
_periodId identifies the period whose balance details are ensured
_periodId is validated as a strictly past period before claiming
_guardian is used to read the active balance for the pro-rata share
_guardian is the authenticated claimer and the transfer recipient
_claimGuardianShare sets claimedGuardians[_guardian][_token] = true before transferring
_claimGuardianShare performs the transfer of the computed guardian amount
native token branch of _transfer executes _to.send(_amount)
ERC20 branch of _transfer performs an external safeTransfer call
ETH send to the guardian can trigger a fallback while the claim flow is still executing
ERC20 token callback during a claim transfer could re-enter the claim workflow
claimGovernorShare delegates to _claimGovernorShare
_claimGovernorShare transfers the accumulated governor share
_claimGovernorShare sets claimedGovernor[_token] = true on the period
recoverFunds reads the funds governor address from the controller in its modifier
the governor share recipient is derived from the controller config governor address
_setGovernorSharePct writes the governorSharePct state variable
_governorSharePct is validated with PctHelpers.isValid and then stored
recoverFunds sends the full ETH balance to _to with send
send to the recipient can re-enter recoverFunds through the recipient fallback
_to is the recipient of the recovered ETH balance
_heartbeat advances the termId state variable after processing transitions
_neededTermTransitions reads terms[termId].startTime to compute pending transitions
periodDuration bounds the randomness-derived checkpoint term selection

normalization_plan.reason: input parameter only forwarded to the config setter; carries no standalone state and can be folded into the setConfig core node
recipient parameter used solely by the native send in recoverFunds and can be merged into that unsafe operation
token address parameter driving the payment split and deposit branch, best represented on the pay core function
amount parameter used for share computation and deposit consistency checks, merged into pay
period identifier validated and used only within the guardian claim flow
guardian address authenticated and paid inside the guardian claim flow, no separate semantics
permyriad value only validated and stored by the governor share setter
module address parameter used only to index allModules inside the disable/enable flow
temporary local holding the ensured Court term inside setConfig, not a persistent value
intermediate share amount computed inside pay and immediately accumulated in the period mapping
intermediate remainder computed inside pay and immediately accumulated in the period mapping
target local only carries the customFunctions lookup value into the fallback low-level call
storage reference local used solely to toggle the disabled flag inside disableModule
